newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan lowers fuel oil bunker prices by $8/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan lowers fuel oil bunker prices by $8/T.

text.p: Taiwan's Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has lowered its bunker fuel prices by $8 per tonne effective January 13, a company statement said on Wednesday.

Posted prices for 180, 280 and 380 centistoke bunker fuel delivered at the ports of Keelung, Hualien, Taichung and Suao were decreased by $8 per tonne, to $144. Term prices were also down by $8 to $141 per tonne.
Spot and term bunker C grade were also lowered by $8, to $142 and $139 respectively.
CPC is Taiwan's sole supplier of bunker fuels.
